messages:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU pool primary-us-east-1 is reporting sustained eviction events and queue length > 10k for 5m. Autoscaler attempted 3x but hit quota. Impact: elevated latency and throttling for hosted-api customers. Paging tara (oncall) and matt.

tara (oncall): on it. joining call now. any immediate mitigation suggestions?

matt: reading metrics — eviction spikes correlate with preemption events on the primary pool nodes around 18:12 UTC. autoscaler logs show 'quota_exceeded' when trying to create replicas. queue growth from 800 -> 11,200 in ~4m.

jin: confirm: routing policy should spill to secondary-region by priority when primary saturates, but smart-router didn't trigger because pool still reported alive and had capacity percentage above threshold. looks like threshold logic is wrong — using 'free_gpu_percent' vs 'task_queue_ms' threshold.

sofia: customers reporting 5-25s extra latency and some 429s from premium tenants on dedicated capacity. CS thread catching a couple customers. tagging product-svcs.

opsbot: autoscaler request failed: API error 403 QuotaExceeded: gpu-cores quota at 100. Attempted +8 GPUs.

arjun: copying relevant autoscaler error:
```
2026-03-15T18:14:22Z ERROR autoscaler: provision failed status=403 body={"error":"QuotaExceeded","message":"Requested 8 gpus, available 0"}
2026-03-15T18:14:23Z WARN scheduler: eviction detected on node gpunode-78 (preempted)
```

tara (oncall): immediate plan: 1) reduce incoming admission on primary region (throttle lower tier) 2) force routing spill to eu-west-1 for non-low-latency flag customers 3) open emergency quota request with cloud for replacement nodes. I'll start 1 and 2 now.

matt: +1. Also start a canary model downgrade for non-critical model variants to reduce memory pressure (quantized variant). jin can you prepare the routing override?

jin: preparing override. route policy patch: set primary.max_queue=2000, overflow_target=eu-west-1, overflow_policy=immediate. Will apply in 30s.

product-svcs: FYI — toggling spillover might affect EU regional latency. coordinate with CDN team for header-based routing.

sofia: posting to affected-customers channel with initial impact: degraded latency, some 429s. billing note: no data loss.

opsbot: override created: routing/overflow set -> eu-west-1. Old policy saved as routing/overflow@2045678910.bak

matt: applying canary quantized model to 10% traffic in primary - command: `rictl rollout model-id=redwood/llama-q10 percent=10 region=us-east-1`

arjun: quantized canary started. memory footprint for pods down ~30%. hope to drain queues faster.

30s later

incident_bot: Update: overflow routing in effect. Observed drop in primary queue from 11.2k -> 3.1k in 2m. eu-west-1 ingress increased by ~2.8k requests.

sofia: CS updated customers: mitigation in place, we are routing to EU region and working on capacity.

opsbot: quota request submitted to cloud provider support ticket #CP-87214. ETA unknown.

matt: next step: scale up dedicated reserved pool in secondary region for stable throughput. that requires finance approval if >72h. tara, can you approve emergency capacity for 24-48h?

tara (oncall): I can approve short-term emergency spend up to $10k on calendar approval. initiating finance ping now.

jin: note: router fallback created potential mismatch in model variants (primary = full fp16, eu-west-1 default = 4-bit quantized). we saw a small uptick in hallucination rate on a few reranked responses. product-svcs: advise on risk to SLAs.

product-svcs: accept temporary quality variance for degraded paths; open a follow-up to measure regression and notify impacted enterprise customers.

sofia: started a webhook to mark all in-flight requests routed to eu-west with tag `spillover-2045678910` for post-incident eval.

1h mark

incident_bot: Update: primary us-east-1 stable, eviction events subsided. Queue now 600. eu-west-1 steady. Autoscaler still showing quota issue for new nodes.

matt: rollback plan: keep spillover active for another 2hr while cloud ticket is open. don't revert until quota resolved. schedule a canary revert once node replacement confirmed.

arjun: running s3 dump of request traces for the 18:10-19:30 window: path /v1/chat/completions shows median latency 1.2s (pre-incident) -> 3.8s (incident), p95 18s. attaching trace ids to postmortem.

tara (oncall): handoff note for next oncall: incident not fully resolved; autoscaler quota pending; keep spillover policy active, monitor eu-west costs and quality regressions. If eu-west queue grows >5k, escalate to SRE lead.

sofia: closing customer notifications loop for now, CS will follow up with impacted customers with incident summary and mitigation steps.

incident_bot: Incident severity: S2 (degraded for multiple customers) - assigned incident lead: tara (oncall). Recommend postmortem within 48h.

matt: creating postmortem ticket and ops runbook updates: fix routing threshold to consider queue_ms and eviction_rate, not just free_gpu_percent. assign to jin + eng-runtime.

jin: ack. I'll also add an autoscaler guard: if provision fails with QuotaExceeded twice within 5m, trigger immediate overflow routing.

product-svcs: request: include a short customer-facing blurb for the support portal. i'll draft.

sofia: thanks team. tagging this thread for the postmortem.

incident_bot: Incident closed for paging. Thread will remain for follow-ups.
